text: Implemented typed event/nuisance target partitioning for compressed ReducedRankGls. Added ReducedRankDesignPartition with smart validation; FitInterpreter derives event columns as reduced-rank targets and baseline/nuisance columns as residualized nuisance from DesignColumnSource, avoiding positional or string-based dispatch. The compressed shared-GLS path now residualizes target design and response against nuisance columns, fits the reduced target subspace with the fmrireg QR/SVD construction, estimates nuisance coefficients on the remaining whitened signal, and embeds both back into the full coefficient surface for chunk decoding. Model validation now bounds fixed reduced-rank components by event/task capacity rather than all predictors. Added a partitioned fmrireg-style fixture and public FitPlanExecutor regression for event-target reduction after nuisance residualization; updated chunked RRG coverage to use a real two-event compressed target model; updated fit README. Evidence: sbt modelJVM/test modelJS/test fitJVM/test fitJS/test passed 16/16/126/121; scoped git diff --check clean; explicit trailing-whitespace scan clean for tracked and untracked touched files. Remaining: energy/RSS rank policies, bootstrap/task-only inference result policy, and voxelwise-AR compressed RRG.
